极性：同山明暗
工具：内置 image_gen，透明背景。
用途：1.3 二：极性页首，表现同一山体的差异与共同归属；不使用太极、旋涡或创生意象。
最终提示词：
Create one epic fine-art editorial illustration for the hero of a Chinese philosophy webpage about POLARITY AND THE RELATIVE WORLD. Nearly square canvas, approximately 5:4. A SINGLE CONTINUOUS monumental mountain massif seen from an elevated oblique viewpoint, exquisite ancient Chinese monumental landscape painting with restrained mineral pigments, ink wash and detailed topographic strata. The same mountain has clearly different faces: one enormous slope in deep charcoal and muted moss green shadow, the adjacent slope in warm ivory and subtle antique-gold morning illumination. Both faces visibly meet along ONE natural jagged ridge and share the same rock strata and foundation. The light and shadow remain distinct while belonging to one mountain. Layered smaller peaks recede through pale mist below, giving tremendous depth and scale. A very small muted-gold sliver of light touches a distant horizon. Epic through vastness, immense silent mountains, refined depth and composition; contemplative, authoritative, elegant. This illustration shows difference, relative position, light and shade, and one shared world. It must NOT suggest a mechanism of cosmic generation. Absolutely NO yin-yang or taiji emblem, NO circle enclosing composition, NO S-shaped split, NO two circular eyes, NO spiral, vortex, energy whirlpool, circular rotation, cosmic explosion, galaxy, stars, dragons, symbols, words, inscriptions, seals, or people. Do not divide the picture into a black half and a white half: show real interconnected faces of the same mountain in light and shade. Use limited website palette charcoal #232925, moss #59664f, warm ivory #efeee8, aged gold #c6aa7c. Preserve generous transparent surrounding negative space. Outer mountain and cloud edges taper naturally into genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no rectangular paper texture or solid backdrop, no frame. This will sit on warm ivory paper. Keep bold readable silhouettes at small hero size, with exquisite detailed mountain texture at full size. A landscape illustration, not a logo, not a medallion, not photorealistic.
